symbols.name: IRequester
symbols.summary: Defines the interface for dispatching requests.
symbols.remarks: This interface provides methods for sending requests to their handlers through a pipeline of behaviors and retrieving registration information about handlers and behaviors.

symbols.name: SendAsync(TRequest, SendOptions, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Dispatches a request to its handler asynchronously.
